caption:
You can interrogate a podcast after it's over — and it actually answers you.

Think about the last podcast that gave you one genuinely great line. A framework, a book title, a way of thinking about money or work that you told yourself you'd remember. Did you? Or is it sitting somewhere in a 90-minute episode you'll never scrub back through to find.

Snipd is an AI podcast player (iOS and Android) built around a simple idea: listening shouldn't mean losing information. A few things worth knowing about it:

→ Triple-tap your headphones mid-episode and it saves the clip, the transcript, and an AI summary automatically — before you've even pulled your phone out.
→ "Chat with Episode" lets you type a question about something the host or guest said, days later, and it answers using the actual transcript. Not a summary of the vibe — the actual words.
→ AI-generated chapters break long episodes into topics, so you can skip straight to the 8 minutes you wanted out of 90.
→ Guest Detection tells you who's talking as they talk, so you're not pausing your walk to Google a name.
→ Everything exports to Notion, Obsidian, Readwise, or Markdown, so it lives in your notes instead of disappearing into the app.

One honest limit: it's built for English-language podcasts, and it works best as a layer on top of your existing podcast app rather than a full replacement. Reviewers who used Airr before it shut down consistently point to this as its closest successor — it's on the App Store and Google Play with 100K+ downloads already.
